summary: Frontend-only verification of Phase H Batch 1 — Safety Meeting evolution. 100% pass across all 12 acceptance criteria: (1) 22 chips render in correct operational order with EXACT expected counts (All=128, Pipe=3, Excavation=4, Grading=5, Concrete=12, Paving=3, Milling=1, MOT=13, Trucking=12, Dewatering=8, Shop=8, Plant=8, Airport=2, Utilities=2, Rigging=2, FallProt=5, Electrical=4, ConfinedSpace=1, Environmental=3, Wellness=6, Office=8, General=18), zero mismatches; (2) Each new chip filters correctly to its expected item count; (3) Chip row overflows-x with hidden scrollbar at 320px (scrollWidth=2076 vs clientWidth=206) — scrolls cleanly without bleed; (4) All 17 Phase H Batch 1 EN topics carry the 'WHAT HAPPENS · real-world pattern' header followed by a field-foreman-voice incident paragraph and existing bullets (trenching_shoring, soil_classification, mot_setup, flaggers, live_traffic, mot_moving_trucks, lane_closures, shoulder_closures, detour_routing, pavement_marking, sign_installation, crash_cushion, vms_signs, barrier_placement, mot_survey_crew_exposure, excavation_potholing_daylight, excavation_spoil_placement); (5) All 4 critical ES samples (trenching_shoring, mot_setup, flaggers, barrier_placement) plus the 3 new gap-fill topics carry 'PATRÓN REAL · lo que suele pasar' in ES with no EN leakage; (6) Legacy `dewatering` key fully removed — Dewatering chip count is exactly 8 (Phase D); (7) Regression untouched topics (ppe_general, hot_work) load without crash and contain NO header — only Batch 1's 17 are uplifted; (8) ES chip labels match operator spec exactly: Todos · Tubería · Excavación · Movimiento · Concreto · Pavimento · Milling · MOT / Tráfico · Camiones · Desagüe · Taller · Planta / Lab · Aeropuerto · Servicios · Aparejo / Grúa · Caídas · Eléctrico · Esp. Confinado · Ambiental · Calor / Fatiga / SM · Oficina · General; (9) Tone sampling on live_traffic, flaggers, and excavation_potholing_daylight reads as superintendent / field-foreman voice (phrases like 'Flagger fatalities are remembered by name in this industry', 'Most fatal intrusions happen at the BUFFER, not the work area', 'the operator hit something with the bucket trying to find it') — well above LMS/corporate bar; (10) Zero JS console errors across all interactions (EN+ES, 320/1280, picker open/filter/select). Three new gap-fill topics confirmed under correct chips: mot_survey_crew_exposure under MOT (count 13), excavation_potholing_daylight & excavation_spoil_placement under Excavation (count 4).

critical_code_review_comments: Nit (carryover): TopicPicker.jsx still keeps the 'All' chip visible regardless of topic count via visibleChips filter — fine in current usage with 128 topics, would show 'All 0' if topics array were ever empty.
Nit (carryover): NewMeeting.jsx composeNotes helper appears to still be duplicated between applyTemplate and submit (per iter258 review). Not blocking.

Code health observation: 17 Batch 1 topics use the same pattern of `discussion_notes` + separate `incident_pattern` field, and composeNotes prepends the localized header. Clean separation — easy to extend to remaining 46 unprocessed General topics in future batches.

Suggestion (non-blocking): meetingTopicLibrary.js has grown to 2050 lines and .es.js to 1559 lines. Consider splitting into per-domain files (e.g. /topics/mot.js, /topics/excavation.js) before the next batch lands, both to keep files <700 lines and to make per-batch diffs reviewable. Not required this cycle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase H Batch 1 (17 topics: 12 MOT + 2 Excavation + 3 new gap-fill) verified end-to-end. Chip row is now 22 entries (21 domains + All). Legacy `dewatering` key has been deleted from both EN and ES libraries; Phase D set of 8 dewatering_* topics stays under Dewatering chip. Critical detail for next agent: the picker search filter matches on `title + es-title + category + key` — searching by the topic_key string directly will NOT match (search uses lowercased title substring). To load a specific topic by data-testid, open picker, scroll_into_view_if_needed on `[data-testid=topic-picker-item-<key>]`, then click(force=True). Total library is now 128 EN + 128 ES entries; 63 carry incident_pattern (46 from prior phases + 17 from Batch 1). Remaining ~46 untagged-as-General topics are next candidates for uplift. Bilingual parity is intact for the operator's review.
